changed.title: A fan-in-two circuit counts matching keys and returns the least one from a tree of cyclic history equations
changed.statement:
∀ (k r q n w : Nat) (hk : 0 < k),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin k → F
  let X := W × (Bool → Fin (r+1) → W)
  let G := Bool × Fin r × Fin k
  let I := Fin k ⊕ G
  let N := (2*r+3)*k
  let ix := fun s : Nat => (⟨s % k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let rot := fun (s : Nat) (v : W) (j : Fin k) => v (ix (j.val+k-s % k))
  let start := fun (b : Bool) => if b then 3 else 1
  let feed := fun (b : Bool) (t : Nat) => if b then 3*(t+1)+1 else 2*t
  let mix := fun (b : Bool) (v : W) (j : Fin k) =>
    let d := if b then 2 else 1
    v j + v (ix (j.val+d)) + v (ix (j.val+k-d % k))
  let pair := fun (v z : X) => dotProduct v.1 z.1 +
    ∑ s : Fin (r+1), (dotProduct (v.2 false s) (z.2 false s) + dotProduct (v.2 true s) (z.2 true s))
  let form : I → Fin 3 → X → F := Sum.elim (fun j _ z => z.1 j) (fun g e z =>
    let b := g.1
    let t := g.2.1
    let j := g.2.2
    let y := mix b (z.2 b t.castSucc)
    if e.val = 0 then y (ix (j.val+1)) else if e.val = 1 then y (ix (j.val+2))
    else z.2 b t.succ j + y j + rot (feed b t.val) z.1 j)
  let inputs := (2+2*r)*k+q*(N+1)+n*((2*r+1)*k)
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (ok : Fin (inputs+C.size))
    (countWire : Fin (k+1) → Fin (inputs+C.size)) (keyWire : Fin k → Fin (inputs+C.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs C ∧
    C.output = ok.val ∧ C.size ≤ 2^(90+(3*min N w)/2)*(k+r+q+n+5)^40 ∧
    ∀ (name : Bool → W) (c : Bool → Fin r → W) (obs : Fin q → X) (rhs : Fin q → F)
      (bag : Fin n → I → Bool),
      let pack := fun v : W => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin k => decide (v j ≠ 0))
      let lanes := fun (side : Bool) (tape : X) => (List.finRange (r+1)).flatMap (fun j => pack (tape.2 side j))
      let leafBits := fun (p : I → Bool) => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin k => p (.inl j)) ++
        [false,true].flatMap (fun b => (List.finRange r).flatMap (fun t =>
          List.ofFn (fun j : Fin k => p (.inr (b,t,j)))))
      let bits := pack (name false) ++ pack (name true) ++
        [false,true].flatMap (fun b => (List.finRange r).flatMap (fun t => pack (c b t))) ++
        (List.finRange q).flatMap (fun i => pack (obs i).1 ++ lanes false (obs i) ++ lanes true (obs i) ++
          [decide (rhs i ≠ 0)]) ++ (List.finRange n).flatMap (fun v => leafBits (bag v))
      let wire := fun i : Fin (inputs+C.size) => (C.wires bits).getD i.val false
      let D := {z : X // (∀ b, z.2 b 0 = rot (start b) z.1) ∧ ∀ i, pair (obs i) z = 0}
      let span := fun (p : I → Bool) => Submodule.span F
        {f : D → F | ∃ (j : I) (e : Fin 3), p j = true ∧ f = fun z : D => form j e z.val}
      let layout := (∃ root : Fin n, ∀ j, bag root j = true) ∧
        ∀ v : Fin n, (∃ one : I, ∀ j, bag v j = decide (j = one)) ∨
          ∃ l h : Fin n, l < v ∧ h < v ∧ (∀ j, bag l j = true → bag h j = false) ∧
            ∀ j, bag v j = (bag l j || bag h j)
      let fits := layout ∧ ∀ v : Fin n,
        Module.finrank F ((span (bag v) ⊓ span (fun j => !(bag v j))) : Submodule F (D → F)) ≤ w
      let actual := fun (key : W) (b : Bool) (time : Fin (r+1)) =>
        ((List.finRange r).take time.val).foldl (fun prev tick =>
          let y := mix b prev
          fun j : Fin k => y j + (1+y (ix (j.val+1)))*y (ix (j.val+2)) +
            rot (feed b tick.val) key j + c b tick j) (rot (start b) key + name b)
      let hit := fun key : W => ∀ i, pair (obs i) (key,actual key) = rhs i
      let cnt := Nat.card {key : W // hit key}
      let out := fun j => (if wire (keyWire j) then 1 else 0 : F)
      let code : W → Nat := fun v => ∑ j : Fin k, if v j = 0 then 0 else 2^j.val
      (wire ok = true ↔ fits) ∧ (∀ s, wire (countWire s) = (if wire ok then cnt else 0).testBit s.val) ∧
        (wire ok = true → 0 < cnt → hit out ∧ ∀ key, hit key → code out ≤ code key) ∧
        ((wire ok = false ∨ cnt = 0) → out = 0)
changed.unlocks: Counts and selects a common raw key when the two cyclic updates and observations have a supplied narrow tree of local equations.
changed.context: Solve initial and observation equations on the complete tape. Each product leaf now reads three affine forms. At a cut keep counts indexed by restrictions to the intersection of the two form spans. At a split, compatible child assignments glue uniquely. Enumerate the local relation or its Fourier orthogonal, whichever has smaller dimension, at most floor(3w/2). Batched sorting implements table lookups. Count again with high raw bits fixed successively at their leaves to recover the least key without changing width.

changed.title: Quadratic test lists certify regular-target decoder loss, and smaller lists admit fair OR-only counterexamples
changed.statement:
∀ N t : ℕ, N < 2*t → t < N →
  let X := Fin N
  let L := 2*N*(N-1)
  let graph := X → X → Bool
  let reg := fun (T : graph) =>
    (∀ x, (Finset.univ.filter (fun y => T x y)).card = t) ∧
    (∀ y, (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => T x y)).card = t)
  let Circ := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit
  let tab := fun (C : Circ) (x y : X) => C.eval (PEqualNP.Represents.oneEach x y)
  let area := fun (C : Circ) => ((Finset.univ : Finset (X × X)).filter (fun z => tab C z.1 z.2)).card
  let loss := fun (C : Circ) (T : graph) => ((Finset.univ : Finset (X × X)).filter
    (fun z => tab C z.1 z.2 ≠ T z.1 z.2)).card
  ∃ test : Fin L → graph, (∀ i, reg (test i)) ∧
    ∀ (g r s : ℕ), 0 < r → r ≤ s → r+s = g+1 → r*s < N → 2*g+1 < N →
      let A := (g+1)*N-r*s
      let a := 2*t-N
      let V := ((N*t : ℕ) : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)*(A : ℝ)/(N : ℝ)
      let fits := fun (C : Circ) =>
        PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N+N) C ∧ C.output < N+N+C.size ∧
        (∀ gate ∈ C.gates, gate.inputs.length ≤ 2 ∧
          (gate.op = .or ∨ gate.op = .and ∨ (gate.op = .not ∧ gate.inputs.length = 1))) ∧
        C.size ≤ g ∧ area C ≤ A
      let lines := fun (C : Circ) => ∃ R S : Finset X, R.card+S.card = g+1 ∧
        ∀ x y, tab C x y = decide (x ∈ R ∨ y ∈ S)
      let c := Nat.gcd (N / Nat.gcd N r) (N / Nat.gcd N s)
      (∀ (M : ℕ) (D : Fin M → Circ) (w : Fin M → ℝ) (h : ℝ),
        (∀ i, fits (D i) ∧ 0 ≤ w i) → (∑ i, w i) = 1 → 0 ≤ h →
        let err := fun T => ∑ i, w i*(loss (D i) T : ℝ)
        (∀ j, err (test j) ≤ V+h) →
          (∀ T, reg T → err T ≤ V+(((N-1)*t*(N-t) : ℕ) : ℝ)*h) ∧
          (a : ℝ)*((N-r*s : ℕ) : ℝ)*
            (∑ i, @ite ℝ (lines (D i)) (Classical.propDecidable _) 0 (w i)) ≤ (N : ℝ)*h) ∧
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (Q : Fin m → graph), m ≤ (N-1)^2 → (∀ j, reg (Q j)) →
        ∃ (M : ℕ) (D : Fin M → Circ), 0 < M ∧
          ((∃ u : ℕ, c = 2^u) → ∃ u : ℕ, M = 2^u) ∧
          (∀ i, fits (D i) ∧ area (D i) = A ∧ ∀ gate ∈ (D i).gates, gate.op = .or) ∧
          (∀ j, (∑ i, (loss (D i) (Q j) : ℝ)) ≤ (M : ℝ)*V) ∧
          ∃ T, reg T ∧ (M : ℝ)*V < ∑ i, (loss (D i) T : ℝ)
changed.unlocks: This would reduce decoder certification on regular targets to a quadratic test list and show how a shorter list can miss excess loss in a fair circuit mixture.
changed.context: Average the tested losses to bound area deficit and use the switch tests on the negative acceptance table. Any circuit lacking the forced line union loses N-rs area. Against m tests find a nonzero rational zero-margin matrix orthogonal to their m-1 differences and sign it to pass. Another regular graph detects positive excess. Expand integer checkerboards as four signed rectangles. Add these counts to a flat list with enough copies of every rectangle, keeping length fixed. Permuted copies of an attaining dyadic list give a dyadic baseline when allowed. Use OR trees for the unions.
